original_query: select s_acctbal, s_name, n_name, p_partkey, p_mfgr, s_address, s_phone, s_comment from part, supplier, partsupp, nation, region where p_partkey = ps_partkey and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey and p_size = 3 and p_type like '%NICKEL' and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_regionkey = r_regionkey and r_name = 'AMERICA' and ps_supplycost = ( select min(ps_supplycost) from partsupp, supplier, nation, region where p_partkey = ps_partkey and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey and s_nationkey = n_nationkey and n_regionkey = r_regionkey and r_name = 'AMERICA' ) order by s_acctbal desc, n_name, s_name, p_partkey limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH eligible_parts AS (
    SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_mfgr
    FROM part p
    WHERE p.p_size = 3
      AND p.p_type LIKE '%NICKEL'
),
min_cost AS (
    SELECT ps.ps_partkey,
           MIN(ps.ps_supplycost) AS min_ps_supplycost
    FROM eligible_parts ep
    JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = ep.p_partkey
    JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
    WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA'
    GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
)
SELECT s.s_acctbal,
       s.s_name,
       n.n_name,
       p.p_partkey,
       p.p_mfgr,
       s.s_address,
       s.s_phone,
       s.s_comment
FROM eligible_parts p
JOIN min_cost mc
  ON mc.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN partsupp ps
  ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
 AND ps.ps_supplycost = mc.min_ps_supplycost
JOIN supplier s
  ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN nation n
  ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
JOIN region r
  ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA'
ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC, n.n_name, s.s_name, p.p_partkey
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Replace the correlated scalar subquery `ps_supplycost = (SELECT MIN(ps_supplycost) ...)` with a pre-aggregated derived table/CTE (`min_cost`) computing MIN(ps_supplycost) once per part for AMERICA suppliers, then join back. This avoids repeated SubPlan evaluation per part/partsupp row.

Extract highly selective part predicates (p_size = 3, p_type LIKE '%NICKEL') into an `eligible_parts` CTE so both the aggregation and the final join operate only on candidate parts, drastically reducing partsupp rows processed.

Convert comma-style joins to explicit INNER JOINs with clear join keys; the min_cost CTE is joined on ps_partkey with equality on ps_supplycost, enabling hash joins instead of a nested-loop join-filter with subplan.
